entities.summary: Ethel May Caterham is an English supercentenarian who, at the age of 116 years, 225 days, has been the world's oldest verified living person since the death of Inah Canabarro Lucas on 30 April 2025. She is the oldest British person in recorded history and the last known surviving validated individual born in the 1900s decade.
